clips.speaker: Bloomberg
clips.title: 美国消费支出回升 通胀创三年新高

subtitles.en: I mean, that's been the story for us all year. We've been calling this the overheating economy.
subtitles.zh: 这是我们全年都在讲的故事，我们称之为经济过热。

subtitles.en: That's been our base case. And that's nominal GDP growth, five and a half, six percent or higher, and that feels like where we're landing.
subtitles.zh: 这是我们的基准情景，名义GDP增长5.5%到6%或更高，感觉我们正朝这个方向走。

subtitles.en: And if you look at huge numbers. That's shining alike. It's very strong.
subtitles.zh: 看看这些庞大的数字，同样亮眼，非常强劲。

subtitles.en: I've got yellow numbers here in the screen folks, are yellow.
subtitles.zh: 屏幕上的数字是黄色的，各位。

subtitles.en: It's banana republic yellow. Yeah. Is that good that we have a five plus percent nominal?
subtitles.zh: 这是香蕉共和国的黄色。名义增长超过5%是好事吗？

subtitles.en: Well, if we look at the real side, that's a good story.
subtitles.zh: 从实际角度看，这是个好消息。

subtitles.en: We've had a pretty resilient economy driven by AI CapEx, a resilient upper income consumer, fiscal support in the first half.
subtitles.zh: 经济相当有韧性，得益于AI资本支出、高收入消费者和上半年财政支持。

subtitles.en: But that worrying part is the inflation of that nominal GDP story, far above the Fed's target, far too high.
subtitles.zh: 但令人担忧的是名义GDP增长中的通胀部分，远高于美联储目标。

subtitles.en: As we talked about earlier, we think that's going to moderate gradually.
subtitles.zh: 我们之前讨论过，认为通胀会逐步缓和。

subtitles.en: But risks here to the upside and looks like this morning's print came in right in line with expectations.
subtitles.zh: 但风险偏向上行，今早的数据符合预期。

subtitles.en: You're running near three and a half percent on core PC inflation when the Fed targets two percent.
subtitles.zh: 核心PC通胀率接近3.5%，而美联储目标是2%。

subtitles.en: It's going to take a lot of work and a lot of disinflation across categories to get back down to target.
subtitles.zh: 要回到目标水平，需要大量工作，且各品类通胀都要下降。

subtitles.en: And I think that's Kevin Worsh's focus is getting back down to two percent without rounding, not in the vicinity of two, but back down to two.
subtitles.zh: 我认为凯文·沃什的重点是精确回到2%，而不是接近2%。

subtitles.en: Tom, the two-year treasury is down to basis points 4.12 percent on the news here.
subtitles.zh: 汤姆，两年期国债收益率因消息下降至4.12%。

subtitles.en: So Rob, based upon what you heard from Kevin Worsh last week with his first meeting, how do you think he's going to interpret the state of here?
subtitles.zh: 罗布，基于上周凯文·沃什首次会议的表态，你认为他会如何解读当前状况？
